economic_hypothesis: A moderate advance made through many small positive sessions and little downside turnover can represent distributed demand. A bounded-turnover breakout through the prior twenty-session ceiling becomes actionable only when the broader market is causally strengthening, the path has target headroom, and the first later legal close accepts the new price. Low turnover is a supply descriptor inside this hierarchy, not the mother signal.

development.annual_instability_disclosed: 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018, and 2020 do not individually satisfy the pooled return/frequency target; challenge authorization uses only the user's original pooled gates and is not an annual-stability claim.

frozen_mother.market: causal BULL at the completed signal close
frozen_mother.history: exact valid contiguous prior sixty sessions in one coordinate lineage
frozen_mother.distributed_advance: completed current close is 5 to 25 percent above the exact close twenty sessions earlier; at least 60 percent of the prior twenty step returns are positive; prior-twenty maximum absolute step return is below 7 percent
frozen_mother.contracted_selling: prior-twenty downside-turnover sum divided by upside-turnover sum is at most 0.65
frozen_mother.demand_escape: completed signal step return is 2 to 7 percent, close location at least 0.75, coordinate close above the frozen prior-twenty high, and turnover 1.2 to 2.5 times the prior-twenty median
frozen_mother.limit_and_cooldown: non-upper-limit close and first raw event after more than twenty sessions without another raw mother event

frozen_chart_rules.target_corridor: require exact valid prior-126 history and either signal close above its prior-126 high or that high at least 15 percent above signal close; preserve the parent chart rule unchanged even though the execution target is shortened to +10 percent
frozen_chart_rules.market_strengthening: (1 + market median ret20)^3 >= (1 + market median ret60) and market positive-ret20 share >= positive-ret60 share
frozen_chart_rules.crowding: market positive-ret60 share >= 0.80 or same-date mother count <= 25
frozen_chart_rules.acceptance: the first legal completed stock session after the signal within three market sessions must close at or above the signal close; later recovery cannot repair first-observation failure

translation.entry: first legal non-limit-up open strictly after acceptance and no later than acceptance plus three market sessions
translation.horizon: after twenty held market sessions, then first legal sellable open

challenge.primary_gates: mean completed signals per signal year > 50, pooled completed mean net return >= 4 percent, pooled mean holding < 15 sessions
challenge.mandatory_diagnostics: report every signal year separately, especially 2025; report date concentration and results excluding the largest signal date

governance.relationship_to_consumed_2025: The consumed 2025 quiet-inventory failure motivates abandoning low volume as a mother signal, but no post-2021 distributed-accumulation V3 identity or outcome was read before this freeze.
governance.challenge_industry_lineage: Use causal_industry only when industry_valid and historical_identity_valid are true and available_at <= decision_at; do not substitute a current or non-PIT industry snapshot.
